summary.goal: Capture all execution events as trajectories for replay, debugging, and retrospective analysis. Enable learning from past runs to improve future execution.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every state transition (run, task) emits trajectory event
Agent messages and tool calls captured with timestamps
Trajectory events stored with run_id, task_id, event_type, payload, timestamp
GET /runs/:id/trajectory returns full event stream
Query by time range, event type, or task
Aggregate stats endpoint: completion rate, retry rate, avg duration per step type
Trajectory pruning policy (keep N days or N runs)

observations: Event sourcing pattern - state derivable from event stream
Trajectories enable: replay, debugging, retrospective, preference learning
Same pattern as agentworkforce/trajectories but execution-focused
Aggregate stats help identify slow steps, frequent failures
patterns: Event types: task_started, task_completed, task_failed, agent_message, tool_call, gate_reached, gate_resolved

architect.storage: trajectory_events table with run_id, task_id, event_type, payload JSONB, timestamp

steps.title: Define trajectory event types and schemas
steps.description: Define all trajectory event types with Zod schemas

acceptance_criteria.description: TrajectoryEventTypeSchema: enum of all event types (run_started, task_completed, agent_spawned, gate_reached, etc.)
TrajectoryEventSchema: { event_id, run_id, task_id?, event_type, payload: Record<string,unknown>, timestamp }
Payload schemas per event type (e.g., TaskCompletedPayload, AgentProgressPayload, GateReachedPayload)

specification.pattern_description: Copy DecisionEvent pattern from planner-core trajectory domain

steps.title: Create TrajectoryCapture service
steps.description: Service for emitting and storing trajectory events

acceptance_criteria.description: TrajectoryCapture class with emit(runId, eventType, payload, taskId?) method
Auto-generates event_id (UUID) and timestamp
Validates payload against event type schema
Stores via ForgeStorage.createTrajectoryEvent()
Emits to SSE subscribers for real-time updates

architecture.storage: Uses trajectory_events table defined in forge-storage fs-s4

steps.title: Integrate trajectory capture with state transitions
steps.description: Emit trajectory events on all run and task state changes

acceptance_criteria.description: transitionRun() calls trajectoryCapture.emit() for run state changes
transitionTask() calls trajectoryCapture.emit() for task state changes
Agent spawn/exit captured as agent_spawned/agent_exited events
Gate decisions captured as gate_reached/gate_approved/gate_rejected events
Question events captured as human_input_requested/question_answered events

architecture.pattern: Decorator or hook pattern on state transition functions

steps.title: Capture agent MCP tool calls
steps.description: Capture agent MCP tool calls as trajectory events

acceptance_criteria.description: MCP tool handlers call trajectoryCapture.emit() after successful execution
report_progress captured as agent_progress event
record_decision captured as decision_recorded event
report_audit_result captured as audit_completed event
Payload includes tool name, arguments, and result summary

specification.pattern_description: Add trajectory emit calls after successful tool execution
specification.notes: MCP tools pass trajectoryCapture service via handleToolCall dependency

steps.title: Create trajectory query API
steps.description: API endpoints for querying trajectory events

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/trajectory returns full event stream ordered by timestamp
Query params: event_type, task_id, from_time, to_time
Pagination support: limit, offset
Returns { events: [...], total, has_more }

specification.pattern_description: Copy trajectory handler pattern from planner-core

steps.title: Create aggregate stats endpoint
steps.description: Compute and return aggregate statistics from trajectory

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/trajectory/stats returns aggregate metrics
Metrics: completion_rate, retry_rate, avg_task_duration, avg_attempts
Per-step-type breakdown if requested (?by_step_type=true)
Computed from trajectory events, not cached (for now)

architecture.pattern: SQL aggregation queries on trajectory_events table
architecture.future: Consider materialized views or periodic aggregation for performance

steps.title: Implement trajectory pruning policy
steps.description: Automatic cleanup of old trajectory data

acceptance_criteria.description: Configurable retention: FORGE_TRAJECTORY_RETENTION_DAYS (default 30)
pruneOldTrajectories() deletes events older than retention period
Alternative: keep last N runs (FORGE_TRAJECTORY_KEEP_RUNS)
Scheduled via setInterval or cron (daily)

architecture.sql: DELETE FROM trajectory_events WHERE timestamp < datetime('now', '-30 days')

steps.title: Mount trajectory routes on API router
steps.description: Add trajectory routes to the Forge API router

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/trajectory mounted on Forge router
GET /runs/:id/trajectory/stats mounted on Forge router
